# Ondaypad

> A free, ad-free local nostalgia calendar with no account and no subscription.
> Open a month grid, leave notes on any day, and open “this day across years”
> to stack every year’s notes for the same MM-DD. Navigate any date. Export
> and import JSON so a lost phone is not the end. Works as an offline PWA on
> Android and any browser.

Notes and preferences stay in this browser on this device. There is no
account and no cloud sync. The JSON backup is the phone-loss answer.

## Links

- [Home](https://ondaypad.try-dabble.com/): The nostalgia calendar
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/en/guides/ondaypad): How Ondaypad works
- [Privacy](https://ondaypad.try-dabble.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms](https://ondaypad.try-dabble.com/terms.html)

## Features

- Month calendar grid with prev/next, today highlight, days-with-notes marked
- Notes per calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD): optional title + body; multiple notes per day allowed
- “This day across years” stack for any MM-DD (newest or oldest year first)
- Navigate any month / year / date
- JSON export / import (`{ app: "ondaypad", version: 1, notes, prefs }`)
- Local-only amber banner; ko / en / ja / zh via `?lang=`
- No login, no tool-UI ads, no subscription
